verdict.rationale: Martin is a personal AI assistant, so operating a web browser to research and complete website tasks is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents browser control or website task completion. The closest item says Martin syncs with multiple search engines, which is search retrieval, an adjacent feature rather than browser operation. Its other actions run through integrations such as calendar, email, and Slack, not websites.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
